subject: Chair delivery problem
body: Hi, I ordered an office chair from your West Lake store last week and it was supposed to arrive on Tuesday. No one showed up and I didn't get any call or message. I took the afternoon off work for this. When I called the store, the person I spoke to said they'd look into it but I haven't heard back since. Can someone please tell me where my chair is and when I'll actually get it? I really need it for my home office.
